name: fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus'

proof:
lemma fundamental_theorem_of_variational_calculus' {f : Y → V}
    (μ : Measure Y) [IsFiniteMeasureOnCompacts μ] [μ.IsOpenPosMeasure]
    [OpensMeasurableSpace Y]
    (hf : Continuous f) (hg : ∀ g, IsTestFunction g → ∫ x, ⟪f x, g x⟫_ℝ ∂μ = 0) :
    f = 0 := by
  by_contra h
  obtain ⟨x₀, hx₀⟩ := Function.ne_iff.mp h
  have hc := Continuous.inner' (𝕜 := ℝ) f (fun _ ↦ f x₀) hf continuous_const
  obtain ⟨δ, hδ, hpos⟩ :=
    Metric.isOpen_iff.mp (isOpen_lt continuous_const hc) x₀
      (lt_of_le_of_ne real_inner_self_nonneg'
        (Ne.symm (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx₀)))
  letI := hasContDiffBump_of_innerProductSpace Y
  let φ : ContDiffBump x₀ := ⟨δ / 2, δ, half_pos hδ, half_lt_self hδ⟩
  apply ((φ.continuous.mul hc).integral_pos_of_hasCompactSupport_nonneg_nonzero (μ := μ)
    φ.hasCompactSupport.mul_right (fun x ↦ by
      by_cases hx : x ∈ Function.support φ
      · exact mul_nonneg φ.nonneg (hpos (φ.support_eq ▸ hx)).le
      · simp [Function.notMem_support.mp hx])
    (mul_ne_zero (φ.pos_of_mem_ball (Metric.mem_ball_self φ.rOut_pos)).ne'
      (inner_self_eq_zero'.not.mpr hx₀))).ne'
  simpa only [Pi.mul_apply, inner_smul_right'] using hg (fun x ↦ φ x • f x₀)
    (IsTestFunction.smul_right ⟨φ.contDiff, φ.hasCompactSupport⟩ contDiff_const)
